'''1933''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who served within the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation of Planets]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWE1" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> 1933 was part of the Federation's invasion force that [[Capture of Theed/Legends|captured]] the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], where the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was stationed within the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace's]] [[Theed Hangar/Legends|main hangar]]. While in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] [[2163/Legends|2163]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] guarded [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]], but was later destroyed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] during [[Gender/Legends|his]] efforts to escape the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] and her entourage offworld to the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SWE1" />
